third_book_search.label: 12 trials in the third-book search
third_book_search.what: The allocator registry (the search for a third book: Schur and its pre-registered siblings). A new third-book candidate is deflated against this count; C4 asks for DSR ≥ 0.95 at 12 trials.

all_registries.label: about 117 trials across all registries
all_registries.what: Every trial run on this panel in every registry (for example the 72-spec skew grid behind Book 2's overlay and the 12 VCFC trials). Shown as a sensitivity only.

why_they_differ: The DSR penalises the number of tries that could have produced the winner. Only the 12 allocator trials competed for the third-book slot, so they set the pre-registered hurdle; the ~117 count adds unrelated searches (overlays, timing grids, VOID runs) and is the conservative sensitivity.
page_counts_note: Each subject page also shows that subject's own trial count (for example 1 for a single pre-registered spec, 72 for the skew grid). Those count the subject's own registry, not the project.
